newsitem.title: UK: NWE high and low sulphur fuel oil flat.
newsitem.headline: NWE high and low sulphur fuel oil flat.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil was stable on Friday but barge markets were volatile through the day, traders said.
High sulphur barges traded as low as $91.50 fob ARA in the morning but the week's main buyer then said he bought barrels during the day at $97, $98 and $99 fob ARA.

High sulphur cargoes were little changed from Thursday, when a Scottish utility bought a cargo from an ARA player at $98.50 cif NWE. Dealers said the quality of the Scottish material was not representative of the market and assessed prices at least a couple of dollars lower.
Otherwise, activity on the cracked markets was thin.
Low sulphur fuel oil was flat from Thursday, with no signs of fresh buying interest.
A Turkish tender to buy 50,000 tonnes of low sulphur fuel oil was heard to have been won by a trader at a level of $14.50 over the high of fob Med quotes, cif Turkey.
